head_commit.message:
[Issue #8007] Add PUT endpoint to update opportunity (#8620)

## Summary

Work for #8007

## Changes proposed

- Added `PUT /v1/grantors/opportunities/<opportunity_id>` endpoint to
allow grantor users to update an existing opportunity
- Added `OpportunityUpdateRequestSchema` with required fields
(opportunity_title, category) and optional category_explanation
- Added `OpportunityUpdateResponseSchema` returning the full updated
opportunity
- Added `update_opportunity` service function that:
  - Fetches the opportunity by ID (404 if not found)
- Verifies the authenticated user has `UPDATE_OPPORTUNITY` privilege for
the opportunity's agency (403 if not)
  - Rejects updates to non-draft opportunities (422)
  - Always updates all fields
- Supports both JWT (`X-SGG-Token`) and API key (`X-API-Key`)
authentication via `jwt_or_api_user_key_multi_auth`

## Context for reviewers

The endpoint follows the same pattern as the existing `POST
/v1/grantors/opportunities/` create endpoint:
- Uses `jwt_or_api_user_key_multi_auth` for auth, supporting both JWT
tokens and API user keys
- Uses `verify_access(user, {Privilege.UPDATE_OPPORTUNITY},
opportunity.agency_record)` to enforce privilege checks
- After flushing the update, reloads the opportunity with
`selectinload("*")` and
`selectinload(Opportunity.agency_record).selectinload(Agency.top_level_agency)`
to avoid `DetachedInstanceError` when serializing the response

Note: The implementation exposes `opportunity_title`, `category`, and
`category_explanation` as updatable fields. Other Opportunity table
fields (`agency_code`, `is_draft`, `revision_number`) are system-managed
and intentionally excluded.

## Validation steps

1. Start the local API
2. Run `make db-seed-local-with-agencies` to seed test users
3. In Postman, create a draft opportunity to test with:
    - Method: POST
    - URL: http://localhost:8080/v1/grantors/opportunities/
    - Header: X-API-Key: one_agency_opp_edit_key
- Body: { "opportunity_title": "Test Opportunity", "category":
"discretionary" }
    - Note the opportunity_id from the response
4. Send a PUT request to update it:
    - Method: PUT
- URL: http://localhost:8080/v1/grantors/opportunities/<opportunity_id>
    - Header: X-API-Key: one_agency_opp_edit_key
- Body: { "opportunity_title": "Updated Title", "category": "research" }
    - Verify response is 200 with updated fields in the response body
5. Verify that omitting a required field (e.g. category) returns 422
6. Verify that using an opportunity not belonging to the user's agency
returns `403`
7. Verify that a non-existent opportunity ID returns `404`
8. Verify that attempting to update a published (non-draft) opportunity
returns `422`
9. Run the test suite: `make test
args="tests/src/api/opportunities_grantors_v1/test_opportunity_route_update.py"`
